findings.text: follow-on: the fallback is unreachable from production — plan_dispatch always sets lane_gate to the dict from _dispatch_lane_gate (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:5908, 5962), so getattr(resolution, "lane_gate", None) is never None and the branch runs only for the two test doubles whose SimpleNamespace omits the field (tests/test_dispatch_counts_worker_slots.py:461, tests/test_the_fleet_gate_holds_dispatch.py:201). It is harmless because re-reading is stricter than the old or-empty-dict, but supplying lane_gate on those doubles would keep production free of a branch no runtime input reaches.
